description: Explain OTP: what it is, the problem it exists to solve, its first principles, and how it actually works. Call this first when someone asks what OTP is, why it was built, what it believes, or how to think about it. Returns the constitution verbatim, plus a short published summary of how it works day to day, so the answer reflects what the product actually commits to rather than marketing copy. Ask for a topic to narrow it. This is public material with no account required. It does NOT carry financials, customer data, or unshipped roadmap.

topic.description: Which part to return. 'overview' = why OTP exists and the working axiom. 'principles' = the full constitution, the laws it holds itself to. 'product' = what it actually does day to day, and how it is positioned. 'everything' = all of it. Defaults to 'overview'.

name: explain_otp
title: Explain what OTP is and why it exists
